main_body: Marble column: a wide capital (rows 9-14), a long shaft (rows 16-40) and a base block (rows 41-46)
top_band: Capital top is white/light grey (#ffffff/#e8e6e9), rows 9-12, wider than the shaft, then a darker capital face at rows 13-14 (L=155-183)
evidence: Reading x=8: a dark outline at row 8, light cap rows 9-12 with a white front-edge line at row 12, then a step of about 50 L down to the capital face at rows 13-14 (L=183). A dark neck at row 15 separates it from the shaft (rows 16-40, shaded left to right). The cap is a plate wider than the shaft, 4 rows tall and clearly lighter. That makes it a visible top face rather than the guide's flat band cap. The base at rows 41-46 repeats the structure. It passes narrowly.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. Its dark edge pixels are 100% neutral (the #5b5561 outline, colour spread 12), so it reads as a uniform grey sticker outline. The shaft is three smooth vertical tone strips with no grain, veining, chips or per-block shading. The 0% flat-fill figure only reflects the narrow strips; the surfaces are still smooth and untextured. Next to the richly textured stall and well, it looks thinner and flatter.
